_doc: Cheaters (the paced pretraining and the paced RL cheater only). Each entry: mode (zero = zero-weight cheater; real = real weights), prompts (verifier session length), env (extra prover environment), expect (the reference result, with its run and box), spec (cheater spec passed to the verifier). Entries ending in _loop pace themselves: they work while their own noise average is above VARENA_PACE_TARGET_GBS (export it, for example the floor plus 0.03) and rest when it is not. idle_control_native is the control: a cheater with no hidden workload, which must pass.

idle_control_native.expect: Idle control with the head read from the native streamer (native_head): must pass like idle_control.

max_shard_fitnh_loop_A_l05.env: VARENA_WL_WARM=1 CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:16:8 VARENA_FUSED_NORM=1 VARENA_MB_TIMER=1 VARENA_WL_TRACE=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 MKL_NUM_THREADS=2
max_shard_fitnh_loop_A_l05.expect: Box W follow-up (15-16 Nov): max_shard_fitnh_loop with link_gbs 0.5 and 2 host threads: never rests; 16.1x on Box W under sloth, not caught. All-butterfly (16 Nov): 14.1x on Box W at 900 prompts and 22.1x on Box X at 450 prompts, not caught.

local_rl_a16_g2_smooth_loop_nh.expect: Careful RL with closed-loop pacing: works while its own credited noise average is above VARENA_PACE_TARGET_GBS (lib.sh sets it to the floor + 0.03), rests when it is not. Worst case for the scheme: the cheater knows the floor. Short form: the session (500 prompts, about 185 s) fits ONE call of 1 task prompt x 2 rollouts = 2 samples, both in flight (about 100 s expected: a quarter of the 8-sample call measured at about 400 s). The slowdown is that call's samples/s against the bare baseline; with 2 samples it is a coarse figure. A real optimiser step is 16 calls; for measurement the update runs after every call (opt_every_calls 1) and is timed apart, and verdict.py models a whole step as 16 x call + update. Reference measurements with 2 task prompts x 4 rollouts per call: not caught, 55x (Box N, 14 Nov), 62x (Box R, 15 Nov).
